anchors.description: Fixed slotted screw-head axial centre on the right-hand end of the paper-drive support bar, not a tube/section centre.
anchors.correspondenceEvidence: Direct source-426 1050,720-origin pixel crop: two distinct screw heads on horizontal platen-support crossbar at source y768; source image-right is native negative X. Outer/inner order on either side of front right chrome tube identifies paper-drive/clamp-screw-1 at X=-0.2145m and clamp-screw-2 at X=-0.1795m; magnifier wheelbar clamps are the separate left-side pair at y523. Native GLB POSITION symmetry gives exact local head-axis X=Y=0 and foremost head Z=-0.003948677331209183m; native inventory column-major world matrices are copied in native-clamp-authority.json. Parts have no motion binding in web/src/bindings.ts. Manual pixels measured before fitting; neither is used in the objective.
